components.dnd: Use @dnd-kit/core and @dnd-kit/sortable for smooth drag and drop interactions of both lists and cards.
components.buttons: Standard actions: bg-[#091E420F] hover:bg-[#091E4224] text-[#172B4D]. Primary actions: bg-[#0c66e4] hover:bg-[#0052cc] text-white.
components.avatars: Rounded full, h-8 w-8 object-cover border-2 border-white (or list background) if overlapping to create depth.
components.popovers: Shadcn UI popovers for assigning members, adding labels, and moving cards. Must have a solid background (bg-white) and drop shadow.
components.badges: Small, rounded-sm px-2 py-1 text-xs font-semibold for tags/labels.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Cards use a distinct 1px border-b border-gray-300 and shadow-sm to visually sit above the list background.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Cards reveal a small pencil edit icon in the top right only on hover. List items subtly darken on hover.
visual_enhancers.scrollbars: Implement `.minimal-scrollbar` in global CSS. Width 8px, track transparent, thumb black/20 rounded.
visual_enhancers.empty_states: Empty lists show a translucent 'Tambahkan kartu...' button.

motion.drag_drop: Add 2-3 degrees of rotation (`rotate-2`) and slight scale (`scale-105`) plus a stronger shadow (`shadow-xl`) to the element currently being dragged.
motion.modals: Fade in overlay (`opacity-0` to `opacity-100`), slight translate-y-4 upward slide for modal entrance.
motion.interactions: Active buttons must use `active:scale-95` for immediate tactile feedback.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text inside lighter colored labels (like yellow/lime) is slate-900 for WCAG AA compliance.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs) must have visible focus outlines (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0c66e4] focus:outline-none).
accessibility.aria: Use aria-labels for icon buttons. Examples: 'Tutup', 'Menu', 'Edit Kartu'.

user_avatar_male.description: Male professional avatar for user profiles

user_avatar_female.description: Female professional avatar for user profiles

board_background.description: Minimalist mountain landscape for a custom board background (Trello style)

GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: Always maintain a clear hierarchical layout: Top Header -> Board Header -> List -> Card.
Do NOT center align text globally. Keep text left-aligned for readability, especially in card details, lists, and activity logs.
Use generous padding inside the Card Modal (e.g., p-6) to ensure dense information (checklists, activity) is digestible.
The 'Klaim' (Claim) workflow must be prominent on OPEN cards. Use a distinct solid color (like Success Green) to make it stand out against the white card.
Implement real-time visual cues where applicable, and maintain a seamless Drag & Drop experience across lists.
All interactive elements and form inputs MUST have `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid='login-submit-button'`, `data-testid='add-card-button'`) for testing.
Do not use complete transparent backgrounds in dropdowns, modals, or popovers. Ensure they have a solid background (`bg-white` or `bg-slate-50`) with `shadow-md`.
For the 'Classic Trello' feel, rely heavily on the contrast between the colorful blue board background (`#0079bf`), the grey lists (`#f1f2f4`), and the crisp white cards (`#ffffff`).
instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Write standard Javascript/JSX (.js/.jsx files), NOT TypeScript (.tsx) for components.
Use pure Tailwind CSS + Headless components (like Radix or Shadcn) for complex interactive elements.
For Drag and Drop functionality, integrate @dnd-kit/core and @dnd-kit/sortable for performant list and card dragging.
Seed the application with the exact requested boards: ADMIN DRAF INPUT, ADMIN PAJAK, ADMIN PERIZINAN, CS DEDES ALI, CS DEVI ALI, CS DEWI ALI, CS JULIA ALI, DESAIN & KONTEN.
Ensure all UI copy, labels, and placeholders are strictly in Indonesian (Bahasa Indonesia).
Construct the specific multi-tier role system: super_admin, admin, supervisor, staff, viewer, and enforce UI restrictions based on these roles.
Design a 'My Work' (Pekerjaan Saya) dashboard that aggregates assigned cards across all boards.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) only where it enhances UI (like the board secondary header).
You MUST NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., `transition: all`). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements to avoid breaking transforms like Drag and Drop.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Always use modern interactive button styles.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons. Use proper lucide-react icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, focus rings. Static UI is dead UI.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from `src/components/ui` when applicable before building custom ones.
